import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

def _fit(X, y, it=30):
    n, k = X.shape
    b = np.zeros(k)
    for _ in range(it):
        eta = np.clip(X @ b, -30, 30)
        p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta))
        w = p * (1 - p) + 1e-9
        H = X.T @ (X * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(k)
        step = np.linalg.solve(H, X.T @ (y - p))
        b += step
        if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7:
            break
    eta = np.clip(X @ b, -30, 30)
    return float(np.sum(y * eta - np.log1p(np.exp(eta)))), b

def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float)
    y = np.asarray(feats.y, float)
    n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    base = [np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]]
    B = np.column_stack(base)
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    alpha = 0.05 / p
    sel = []
    ll0, _ = _fit(B, y)
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        best, bj, bll = 1.0, None, None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, s]) >= 0.6 for s in sel):
                continue
            ll, _ = _fit(np.column_stack([B] + [X[:, s] for s in sel + [j]]), y)
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll - ll0), 1)
            if pv < best:
                best, bj, bll = pv, j, ll
        if bj is None or best > alpha:
            break
        sel.append(bj)
        ll0 = bll
    changed = True
    while changed and len(sel) > 1:
        changed = False
        llf, _ = _fit(np.column_stack([B] + [X[:, s] for s in sel]), y)
        for s in list(sel):
            rest = [t for t in sel if t != s]
            ll, _ = _fit(np.column_stack([B] + [X[:, t] for t in rest]), y)
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (llf - ll), 1) > alpha:
                sel.remove(s)
                changed = True
                break
    prods = []
    if sel:
        Xs = np.column_stack([B] + [X[:, s] for s in sel])
        llf, _ = _fit(Xs, y)
        bestp, bpair = 1.0, None
        cand = sel + [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel]
        for a in sel:
            for c in cand:
                if c == a:
                    continue
                extra = [X[:, a] * X[:, c]] + ([X[:, c]] if c not in sel else [])
                ll, _ = _fit(np.column_stack([Xs] + extra), y)
                pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll - llf), len(extra))
                if pv < bestp:
                    bestp, bpair = pv, (a, c)
        if bpair is not None and bestp < 0.01 / (len(sel) * p):
            prods.append((ids[bpair[0]], ids[bpair[1]]))
    drivers = tuple(ids[s] for s in sel)
    cols = list(drivers)
    for a, c in prods:
        for f in (a, c):
            if f not in cols:
                cols.append(f)
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=tuple(cols), products=tuple(prods), loadings={})
